f_term4.finding: F-TERM-4 (V5 terminal): the V5 published scored ledger rows lacked arm_config_digest while the execution report arms carried it.
f_term4.verified_at_base: Reproduced at base 4c804ba: research/control/forex_free_v5_run/scored_ledger_published.jsonl (3/3 rows, uniform 45-key schema forex_free_v3_scored_record_v1) has NO arm_config_digest (and no cycle_id / code_freeze_sha / data_snapshot_digest columns).
f_term4.fix: The V6 scored-ledger row schema (research/assets/forex_free_v6/ledger_row_v6.py) now MANDATES arm_config_digest: build_scored_ledger_row refuses (fail-closed, ARM_CONFIG_DIGEST_REQUIRED / ARM_CONFIG_DIGEST_INVALID) any row without a well-formed 64-char lowercase hex digest computed by compute_arm_config_digest (sha256 over the house canonical JSON — sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8 — of the frozen per-arm config projection; the digest covers whatever fields the freeze gives), and additionally requires the identity fields cycle_id, family_id, arm, trial_id, cell_id, code_freeze_sha, data_snapshot_digest, cost_tier; the V5 45-field row key list is carried as the measured baseline plus the four V6 additions; every row carries schema tag forex_free_v6_scored_ledger_row_v1; append_row publishes append-only (head-prefix verified byte-identical, byte lengths recorded, duplicate record_id refused, foreign head tamper refused via chained head pin).

append_only_publication_statement: append_row implements read-existing-bytes -> append -> re-read and verify head bytes identical + byte length grew by exactly the appended line; refuses duplicates, unparseable/ unterminated pre-existing content, and pinned-head mismatch before any write; a refused call writes nothing.
no_pnl_statement: No PnL computed in P1: the new module is schema + publication machinery only (no booking, no outcome numbers); all test fixtures are synthetic config/identity/structural-counter values with no profitability pins; the regression suites exercise booking on synthetic fixtures only.
verdict_rationale: All P1 deliverables built and green (53/53 new tests; common 57/57; v3 95 passed/2 skipped), and the F-TERM-4 fix is in place fail-closed. The v5 and v4 suites carry 5 pre-existing, environment-coupled failed tests at the base (4 in v5: 2 from the absent gitignored staged snapshot, 2 from committed-control-artifact presence + mtime-freshness coupling; 1 in v4: the same absent staged snapshot). Recorded verbatim as blockers for those suites; not repaired in this lane; kernel regression evidence is therefore PARTIAL until those suites certify on a host with the staged snapshot materialized.
known_limitations: v5/v4 staged-data-dependent tests remain uncertifiable on this host until data_raw/forex_free_v1 (gitignored) is re-materialized; the failure is identical (152/156 digests bad = files absent) in both suites.

The V5 scored-refusal tests are coupled to committed control artifacts (they fail when w4_freeze.json/s0_launch_authorized.json exist, as they do in any tree at base >= the V5 terminal); this is a test-design coupling, not a kernel regression.

append_row's raced-append refusal certifies the violation after the write; the on-disk state is left untouched as evidence (this module never rewrites history). The pre-write chained head pin is the preventive guard.
